h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Silchar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Silchar

items.pText: Silchar is about 2,140 km from our factory in Vasai East, and most buyers here will never see our equipment before it arrives. So the planning has to be done well on paper, using your photos and measurements. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, societies and parks in Silchar and the Barak valley, and sends it by road.

Silchar, on the Barak river in southern Assam, is humid and gets a long, heavy monsoon. Good photos and accurate measurements let us plan your site as if we had visited it. Share them along with the age group of the children, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. You approve the layout and quote before we start manufacturing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Photos to send when we cannot visit your site

items: One wide photo from each corner of the space, so we can see its full shape.
Close photos of the ground surface, any slope, drains and places where water collects.
Photos of trees, poles, walls and overhead wires near the area, and of the gate a delivery vehicle will use.

c: Add the length and width in feet or metres, and mark north on a rough sketch. With this, our layout drawing shows where each piece sits and how much safe play area it needs. For Silchar's wet climate, plan rubber flooring on a raised base. See our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 2,140 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you plan our playground without visiting the site?
items.a: Yes. Most of our layouts are planned from the buyer's photos and measurements. Send wide photos, close-ups of the ground and the length and width of the space.

items.q: Do you deliver to the Barak valley?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India, including Silchar and the surrounding districts. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer who works with us in the Northeast.

items.q: What happens if something is damaged on arrival?
items.a: Check the equipment when it is unloaded and photograph any damage. Then contact our after-sales team at aftersales@funplaysystems.com or +91 738 530 0921.
